metadata.suite_name: FakeDeal Buster Synthetic QA Fixture Suite
metadata.institution: Scholar Institute of Technology and Management (SITM), Guwahati

scenarios.description: Baseline stable product selling at regular price ($100.00) with authentic list MSRP ($120.00).

documented_context.52_week_anchor_source: Catalog inception selling price at t-180 was $120.00, validating price_52w_max = 120.00.

scenarios.scenario_name: Current Price Above Historical Average (Artificial Discount Scam)
scenarios.description: Pre-sale price hiked to $115.00 and MSRP inflated to $150.00 claiming fictitious 23.33% discount.

documented_context.52_week_anchor_source: Catalog inception selling price at t-180 was $120.00. Current selling price of $115 exceeds 30-day baseline of $100.

scenarios.description: Legitimate price markdown from $100.00 down to $75.00 against authentic $120.00 MSRP anchor.

documented_context.52_week_anchor_source: Catalog inception selling price at t-180 was $120.00. Current selling price of $75 delivers genuine 25% savings against 30d baseline.

scenarios.scenario_name: High Advertised Discount with Inflated MSRP Anchor
scenarios.description: Selling price unchanged at $100.00 while reference MSRP is artificially inflated from $100.00 to $250.00 to fabricate a 60% discount.

documented_context.52_week_anchor_source: 52-week trailing maximum selling price was strictly $100.00. MSRP of $250.00 represents 150% reference price inflation.

scenarios.description: Cold-start product with only 5 daily observations (4 historical + 1 evaluation). Insufficient for 30-day baseline calculation.

documented_context.minimum_history_policy: Proposed contract requires N >= 30 daily observations (or minimum 14 for degraded baseline) before scoring.

scenarios.description: Time series containing exactly 15 records with a 14-day calendar gap (2024-01-11 to 2024-01-24 missing).

documented_context.calendar_gap: Observed gap between Jan 10 and Jan 25 is 15 calendar days (14 missing dates). Proposed contract flags discontinuity.

scenarios.description: 31 total records with 29 unique daily records and 2 colliding records sharing composite key (P_TEST_007, bestbuy, 2024-01-30T00:00:00).

documented_context.duplicate_key: ('P_TEST_007', 'bestbuy', '2024-01-30T00:00:00') appears twice with conflicting prices ($45.00 vs $55.00).

scenarios.description: Seven distinct malformed records testing VR-01 through VR-08 schema validation boundaries.

validation_rules: VR-06: Discount exceeds 90% dataset cap (90 < discount_pct <= 100)

scenarios.description: Three records each missing exactly one mandatory schema field (price, original_price, timestamp) with distinct/null timestamps.

documented_context.null_isolation: Distinct timestamps (2024-01-31, 2024-02-01, null) avoid composite key collisions while isolating null rejection.

scenarios.description: Four independent time-series streams (2 products x 2 platforms = 124 records) verifying strict partition isolation by (product_id, platform).

documented_context.isolation_rule: Grouping must strictly be (product_id, platform). Historical statistics from one platform or product must not leak into another.
